title: Farro Grain Bowl with Roasted Vegetables & Chickpeas
description: Nutty farro topped with roasted vegetables, chickpeas and a lemon-tahini dressing.
steps: Roast the courgette, pepper and chickpeas together with oil until golden.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and a little water into a dressing.
Build bowls with farro, the roasted vegetables and chickpeas, and drizzle with dressing.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food vegetarian recipe collection

notes: Farro holds up well for meal prep — cook a big batch and portion it across the week.
